bias: Wild, headline-heavy day, earnings after the bell. Both looked like clean breakdowns early — ES held 7706-12 (never reached the overnight low 7704.5), NQ nuked through its overnight low and held Friday's VPOC — then equities ripped as crude sold (mainstream news notably late). That triggered the LBAF scenario on both and a bullish engulfing day on ES. ES's high printed in the supply at/just above 80-84, protecting Friday's high; NQ's high just under 910 and short of Monday's high. After hours is 'absolutely ripping' on both. Friday's range is now the box as the 'mother bar' — everything since is inside it.
wildcard: 'This after hours float up absolutely ruined the setups, especially for longs.' Trading near today's high with a couple of resistances above, one is almost forced to chase — 'the night is dark and full of terrors (for both sides).' See where we are by morning. The LBAF longs that would have been A/A+ (ES 7746 APBL holding 39-43; NQ 656/653 holding 615-645) are downgraded after the float, more so if a LAAF of today's high is active. ES has an internal broadening formation on cash hours; Friday's ETH high 7809.5 is on the chart.

brief.happened: Opened 7726.75, low 7710.25 at 9:45 (7706-12 held; ON low 7704.5 untouched), ripped to 7791.5 at 10:30 into the supply above 80-84, closed 7759. Bullish engulfing of Monday. Primary distribution ~46-69; APBL 7746; honorable mention 7769; Monday's high 7773 stays on the chart.
brief.pivot: 7769 must sustain after the AH float; 7773 is the first downside warning. Today's high 7791.5 → Friday's RTH high 7803.25 are the first targets up; 39-43 is the line below.
brief.higher: Today's high, then Friday's RTH high 7803.25. Sustain a break of it → cautious of 7815-20, but as long as that doesn't trigger a LAAF of Friday's high AND today's high, bulls regroup and try again for 15-20. A LAAF should come back to 43 (39-43), and below there probably today's low. Above 7815-20 → 7838-41, and big picture above that an ATH retest.
brief.lower: Inside today's range: 69 must sustain, 73 is the first warning (incl. any LAAF of today's high). Back below 69 → risk to 46, with 60-65 potentially supportive for another break of 69 back to 73 and the high. 39-43 lost and offered (especially after this move) → expect at least 23-26.

brief.happened: Opened 29594, nuked through the overnight low 29478.5 to 29391.75 at 9:45 (held Friday's VPOC), ripped to 29903.5 at 10:30 just under 910, short of Monday's high 29983.5, closed 29687.75. Volume contained between 803-822 at the top and just above Monday's 653 low / 615-645 at the bottom. APBL 656.
brief.pivot: Today's high 29903.5 → Monday's high 29983.5 → Friday's RTH high 30045.75, then the big test at 30210-237 (he DOES expect it traded through given Friday's ETH high there). 803-822 / 754-787 must hold after the float.
brief.higher: Today's high, Monday's high, Friday's RTH high, then 30210-237. 30210-237 to 30520-546 is an absolutely massive test point. A LAAF of 210-237 big-picture risks bearish consolidation, but for tomorrow it would need to lose Friday's, Monday's AND today's highs to be meaningfully bearish.
brief.lower: Any LAAF of today's high (incl. Monday's/Friday's) needs to hold 803-822, or 754-787 at worst. Back below 754-787 → likely 615-645 to sweep the 656 APBL. Below 615-645 maybe 569-583 holds, but it must trigger a reclaim of 615-645; holding below 569-583 → today's low and Friday's low, mindful of 469-483.
